en: Water vapor in the air condenses into liquid raindrops when it cools in the clouds.
Solid ice cubes melt into liquid water when placed in a warm glass of calamansi juice.
Iron nails left in the rain react with oxygen to form a new substance called rust.
Muddy river water is a mixture where heavy soil particles slowly settle to the bottom.
Granulated sugar dissolves completely in hot tea to form a clear, uniform liquid solution.
The air inside an inflated balloon is a gas that expands to fill its rubber container.
Burning dry coconut husks produces ash and smoke, demonstrating an irreversible chemical change.
Rain puddles disappear from the school driveway as liquid water evaporates into invisible water vapor.
Solid pumice stones float on ocean water because the porous rock is less dense than the liquid.
Halo-halo is a heterogeneous mixture because you can easily see and separate its distinct solid ingredients.
Solid copper wires used in electric posts are excellent conductors of both heat and electricity.
Steaming liquid rice batter causes a chemical change that turns it into solid, spongy puto.
